input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-t1 from the CO2 rise at reduced speed and the decay at full speed, V = Qe * tau.

monitoring.reason: The two occupants of the Lab breathe the CO2 the test raises; they are also the CO2 source and must stay constant.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow to about 0.3 m3/min so CO2 climbs from 1480 ppm toward a higher equilibrium (about 2500 ppm if V is 30 m3).
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min), record the decay towards equilibrium; fit C(t)=Ceq+(C0-Ceq)exp(-t/tau) after the 3.33 min lag.

abort.when: CO2 of the lab at or above 3000 ppm
the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person out of 45-120 bpm, monitoring lost, or one more person (or one fewer) in the lab

expected.rise: With V near 30 m3 (first guess, default of the fitted range 10-200), 2 occupants awake at 0.38 L/min each and Qe 0.3 m3/min, CO2 rises about 10 ppm/min at first and gains roughly 250-300 ppm over 30 min (peak about 1750 ppm), far under the 2800 limit. Rise rate is roughly proportional to 1/V.
expected.decay: At full speed tau = V/Qe about 30 min for V = 30 m3; CO2 falls toward an equilibrium near 760 ppm (G/Qe), about 1200 ppm at 25 min. The fitted tau times 1 m3/min gives V_lab.
expected.hypothesesHold: Fits of the rise and of the decay give consistent V (within about 15 percent), the residuals are small, and CO2 in hab-b stays flat.
expected.hypothesesFail: Different V from rise and decay, a decay not exponential, or hab-b CO2 moving with the lab's shows exchange through the closed hatch (design flow 3 m3/min) or poor mixing: then the one-zone model is invalid and V_lab is not accepted. A speed command refused, or a person entering or leaving, invalidates the curve.

hypotheses: The hatch is held closed for the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch (station-topology design flow 3 m3/min, larger than the scrubber's Qe) is NOT measured and is a hypothesis, checked only by the hab-b CO2 record.
The lab is one well-mixed zone.
Effective flow scales linearly with speed: Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent, 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent, with a 3.33 min lag.
The 2 lab occupants stay awake at a steady activity, 0.38 L/min each (0.26-0.45 band); the source is held constant, and hab-b's occupants do not enter the lab.
First guess of the volume is 30 m3 (register default, range 10-200), used only to size durations.
